text: Emotional Disposition: Ger. Gefühlsdisposition (Höfler); Fr. disposition émotionelle ; Ital. disposizione all ' emozione , emotività . A permanent mental disposition giving rise to certain kinds of EMOTION (q.v.) on presentation of a certain object. The emotion varies according to the circumstances under which the object is presented. Cf. DISPOSITION. ( G.F.S. , J.M.B. )
